rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the emphatic “not at all” reading, as in “I’m not remotely in love with you.”

example.english: I’m not remotely fond of this movie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zung1 ji3 ne1 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use this for the “hardly” or “scarcely” meaning, when something almost does not happen or apply.

example.english: This issue is hardly remotely important.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gei1 fu4 m4 zung6 jiu3

rows.jyutping: hai2 hou2 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1
rows.note: Use this for doing or being somewhere far away, rather than for negative degree.

example.english: They live remotely, in a faraway place.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 hou2 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1
